title.narrative: Strengthening Protection Environment for Drought-affected IDPs Through GBV Prevention Response in Baidoa District rural areas

description.narrative:
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtThis project will contribute to the Protection Cluster objectives and GBV AoR strategy outcome. The proposed project design aims to provide immediate lifesaving services and mitigate famine risk to GBV survivors, vulnerable women, girls, and boys in Baidoa and especially in Baidoa rural areas through:-lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt1. READO will provide dignity and menstrual kits to 1800 vulnerable individuals (1300 Women, 500 girls), including survivors or at-risk girls and women, based on the survivor-centered approach to cover their holistic needs and in line with Somalia GBV AoR standard, the survivor-centered approach involves prioritizing the needs and preferences of survivors of violence. It is an approach that empowers survivors to take charge of their own recovery and healing process and recognizes that every survivor is unique and has individual needs.lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt2. To address immediate GBV concerns of women and girls, READO will provide Cash Voucher Assistance to 900 GBV survivors (700 Women, 200 Girls) based on a case-by-case approach to prevent and reduce exposure risks.lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt3. To support the case management process and the most vulnerable individuals, READO will procure emergency support, i.e., Non-foods items, including Plastic sheets, Torch, Flask/Plastic thermos, Jerry can (20 liters) Mattresses, Bedsheets, Sleeping Mats, distribute to 400 beneficiaries(300 women, 50 men, 50 boys, and 100 girls) including GBV survivors, Men, Boys, female-headed households, and other women at risk of GBV due to poor lighting systems that expose them to sexual violence at night.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt4. Clinical Management of Rape (CMR) services to 300 GBV survivors within health facilities in-line with WHO CMR guidelines and adherence to ethical standards to improve referral mechanisms for survivors and encourage the survivors to report on timeltbrgt for a timely response within the protocols.lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt5. Provide case management and psychosocial support for 1845 GBV survivors and vulnerable women and children (1390 Women, 345 Girls, 30 Men, 80 Boys) in Baidoa rural areas.lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gt6. Awareness raising and outreach activities on service availability, prevention, and mitigation of GBV to 15,000 individuals. lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black" lang="EN-US"gtREADO will collaborate with the other clusters, including WASH, Health, Nutrition, and CCCM to ensure inter-cluster integration and convergence so the vulnerable community can receive holistic support with various basic needs and services being met. READO will also work with CCCM, in collaboration with the Sub-GBV Working Group, and the Ministry of Women and Human Rights at Southwest Cluster to identify and target the beneficiaries with a focus on those affected by drought to cushion them from the further effect of famine, related to GBV and protection risks. Cash voucher assistance aims to ensure the mitigation of associated risks, including risks of Gender-based Violence (GBV) in order to meet the specific needs and ensure the safety, dignity, and inclusion of diverse groups at risk of famine. lt/spangtlt/pgt
